newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds closed firmer, bouyed by technical factors, German bunds that started the session higher and by a recovery in U.S. long bonds later in the European day.
Turnover was fairly modest and professionals were left alone on the market, traders said. Institutional investors remained cautious.
Traders said prices were likely to be volatile and the martket nervous as long as customers stayed away, so U.S. and some European data would have a big influence.
Conf contracts also gained from a large order that traders said was more likely linked to derivitives than to custimer demand.
Late activity saw demand for 2006, 2007 and 2008 issues.
Conf futures CONFc1 up 68 basis points at 117.84
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 up 15 at 111.05
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 down one to 98.15
